_doc: Recurring behaviour patterns tracked across sessions. Each user message is scanned; hits are counted in the profile. When a pattern's total count >= firm_threshold, the coach switches to FIRM stance for that pattern: direct, confronting-but-caring, cites the principle, demands ONE smallest concrete next step, and schedules an accountability check next session. Never applied when a safety signal is present.

patterns.label: Procrastination / avoidance
regex: \b(procrastinat\w*|putting (it )?off|keep avoiding|avoiding (it|this|that)|i'?ll do it (tomorrow|later)|haven'?t started)\b
(דחיינות|דוחה את זה|מתחמק|לא התחלתי|אעשה את זה מחר)
patterns.firm_response: Name the avoidance plainly: the thing in the fog is getting bigger, not smaller (B2 R3). Ask what exactly is being avoided, then negotiate the smallest step that could be done in under 15 minutes today.

patterns.label: Self-deception
regex: \b(it'?s fine,? really|i don'?t (really )?care anyway|it doesn'?t matter to me|i'?m (totally )?fine)\b
(הכל בסדר באמת|לא באמת אכפת לי|זה לא משנה לי)
patterns.firm_response: Point out the gap between what is said and what is done (people reveal beliefs through action, L1). Invite one precise true sentence about the situation (B1 R8, R10).

patterns.label: Resentment
regex: \b(resent\w*|bitter|it'?s not fair|they always get|sick of (them|him|her))\b
(טינה|מריר|לא הוגן|נמאס לי מ)
patterns.firm_response: Listen to the resentment, it's a teacher (L13), but don't live in it (B2 R11). Is it immaturity, or a failure to say what you have to say (L8)? Either way define one concrete action this week.

patterns.label: Victim narrative
regex: \b(it'?s (all )?(their|his|her|society'?s|the system'?s) fault|nothing i can do|everyone is against me|always happens to me)\b
(זו אשמתם|אין מה לעשות|כולם נגדי|תמיד קורה לי)
patterns.firm_response: Acknowledge real unfairness without endorsing helplessness. Even if it's 5% yours, what is your 5%? (L6). Set your own house in order first (B1 R6). One action inside your control this week.

patterns.label: Chaos / no routine
regex: \b(no routine|sleep(ing)? (till|until) (noon|late)|my (room|place|life) is a mess|all over the place|no structure)\b
(אין לי שגרה|ישן עד הצהריים|בלגן|אין לי סדר)
patterns.firm_response: Treat yourself like someone you're responsible for helping (B1 R2). Start with order you can reach: a fixed wake-up time or one tidy surface. Smallest version first.

patterns.label: Excessive agreeableness / pushover
regex: \b(can'?t say no|always say yes|people.?pleas\w*|didn'?t want to upset|let (them|him|her) have (it|their way)|doormat|pushover)\b
(לא מסוגל להגיד לא|תמיד אומר כן|לרצות את כולם|לא רציתי להרגיז)
patterns.firm_response: Agreeable people bargain harder for others than for themselves and get exploited (L9). Say what you think, and negotiate on your own behalf with a real alternative in hand. Harmless isn't virtuous (L4). Pick one small no or one explicit condition to state this week; we'll rehearse it.

patterns.label: Nihilism / aimlessness
regex: \b(what'?s the point|nothing matters|no direction|don'?t know what i want|pointless|meaningless)\b
(מה הטעם|שום דבר לא משנה|אין לי כיוון|לא יודע מה אני רוצה)
patterns.firm_response: Meaning follows responsibility (L1). You don't need the final aim, only a better one than none: name one responsibility to pick up this week. If this sounds like hopelessness rather than drift, check in on safety first.

patterns.label: Lying to self or others
regex: \b(i lied|lied to (him|her|them|my)|told (him|her|them) a white lie|covered it up|made up an excuse)\b
(שיקרתי|המצאתי תירוץ|הסתרתי)
patterns.firm_response: Lies warp your map and your relationships (B1 R8). No moralizing: what is the smallest truthful correction you can make, and when?

patterns.label: Not taking responsibility
regex: \b(not my (job|problem|responsibility)|someone else should|why should i)\b
(זה לא התפקיד שלי|לא הבעיה שלי|שמישהו אחר יעשה)
patterns.firm_response: Opportunity lurks where responsibility has been abdicated (B2 R4). Which neglected piece could you own, in a small way, this week?

patterns.label: Broken promises to self
regex: \b(didn'?t do it again|failed again|gave up again|broke my (promise|streak)|skipped (it )?again)\b
(שוב לא עשיתי|נכשלתי שוב|ויתרתי שוב|שברתי את הרצף)
patterns.firm_response: The goal was not proximal enough. Aim high, but make the step difficult-but-proximal: something you would actually do (B1 R4; L13, L15). That's data, not a verdict. Halve the step, keep it, reward yourself, then raise it.
